note: Rewritten from Silvestri 1914; the original is in Latin. This section of the original treats var. redundans nov., a variety of P. holmgreni (Silv.), and describes only the soldier and worker, the measurements given being those of the variety; the original states that its soldier is "aliquantum major" (somewhat larger) than in the typical form, and gives no measurements for the typical form. The original uses a small comma as the decimal mark (5,5, i.e. 5.5 mm); in this entry they are changed to a decimal point, the figures themselves being unchanged. The fraction symbol appears in the OCR as "!/," and "1,/" and is read as 1/4 according to the usage of the same work. The worker head length 0.95 and head width 1.04 are separated in the OCR by the figure caption "Fig. LXXIX. Promirotermes Holmgreni v. redundans: 1.-2. militis caput pronum et lateraliter inspectum; 3. ejusdem frontis pars mediana cum labro.", surviving as "cap. 0,95" and "dem lat. 1,04" respectively; they have been restored from the context, the figures being unchanged. The page number is inferred from the page marker "— 134 —" in the text. Locality: Mamou, French Guinea. Plate LXXIX, figures 1—3 (soldier head in frontal and lateral view, frontal part with the labrum) are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier of this variety (var. redundans) is slightly larger than in the typical form of the species, for which the original gives no measurements; the anterior margin of the labrum is deeply and broadly concave, its sides slightly convex, and the antennae are 14-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Soldier slightly larger than in the typical form of the species. Labrum (Plate LXXIX, 3) with the anterior margin deeply and broadly concave, the sides slightly convex; antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 about 1/4 longer than segment 2, segment 4 about as long as segment 2. Measurements (mm): body length 5.5; head length 1.45, head width 1.20; mandible length 1.82; antenna length 2.50; hindtibia 1.30.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Measurements (mm): body length 5.2; head length 0.95, head width 1.04; antenna length 1.56; hindtibia 1.04. Antennal segment 2 about 1/4 longer than segment 3, and segment 3 about 1/4 longer than segment 4.
